necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent dizziness that have persisted despite initial management for supraventricular tachycardia. To further characterize the arrhythmia and correlate symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances, a long-term continuous ECG monitoring study is indicated. This clinical indication supports the medical necessity of CPT 93247 for diagnosis codes I47.1 and R42.
